record.paper_title: Open Problems in Constructive Function Theory
record.original_question: Balanced monic Sobolev orthogonal polynomials are known in a narrow setting to behave like standard orthogonal polynomials for a combined measure built from the two Sobolev measures. Does this remain true in a substantially more general setting?

evidence.quote: QUESTION 4.3. Is this result valid under in a more general situation?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mu_0$ and $\mu_1$ be positive Borel measures on the real line (with all finite moments and infinite support) and consider the Sobolev inner product
$$\langle f,g\rangle_S \;=\; \int f(x)g(x)\,d\mu_0(x) \;+\; \int f'(x)g'(x)\,d\mu_1(x).$$
For each integer $n\ge 1$ let $Q_n$ be the monic polynomial of degree $n$ that is orthogonal with respect to $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_S$. The sequence $\{Q_n\}$ is called balanced when, asymptotically, both terms in $\langle Q_n,Q_n\rangle_S$ contribute on the same scale (i.e. neither the $\mu_0$-part nor the $\mu_1$-part dominates as $n\to\infty$).

In a restricted (e.g. coherent-pair / classical-weight) setting it is known that the balanced monic Sobolev orthogonal polynomials $Q_n$ behave asymptotically like the standard monic orthogonal polynomials with respect to a single "combined" measure $\nu$ canonically constructed from the pair $(\mu_0,\mu_1)$; for instance, ratios $Q_n(z)/P_n(z;\nu)$ converge locally uniformly outside the support of $\nu$ to $1$, and analogous relative-asymptotic and zero-distribution statements hold.

Problem. Determine whether this equivalence between balanced monic Sobolev orthogonal polynomials and standard orthogonal polynomials for a combined measure persists in a substantially broader class of pairs $(\mu_0,\mu_1)$ — beyond the coherent-pair / classical-weight framework — and, if so, identify the appropriate construction of the combined measure and the precise sense (relative outer asymptotics, $n$-th root asymptotics, weak zero asymptotics, etc.) in which the equivalence holds.
artifact.status_search_result: Asymptotics of Sobolev orthogonal polynomials have been established in various coherent-pair and classical settings, but a general theorem identifying balanced monic Sobolev orthogonal polynomials with standard orthogonal polynomials of a combined measure in substantial generality has not been found in the literature; recent works continue to extend results case by case (Jacobi, Laguerre, Gegenbauer, non-coherent pairs), suggesting the general question remains open.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotics for Jacobi–Sobolev orthogonal polynomials associated with non-coherent pairs of measures
status_evidence.snippet: Studies relative asymptotics extending coherent-pair results to broader settings.
status_evidence.claim: General results beyond coherent pairs are still being developed case-by-case.

status_evidence.title: On Sobolev orthogonal polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Survey indicating Sobolev orthogonal polynomial asymptotics is an active and broad area.
status_evidence.claim: No single comprehensive general theorem is identified; the topic remains open.
